1) Dedicated performance (recommended staging config):

- Data residency: US-only tenancy can be enforced for Dedicated pilot; Hosted path requires account-level geo restriction (we’ve included the exact config steps in the runbook snippet).

3) Onramp (updated):
- Staging window: Feb 7–14 (extended one week to include PHI-focused acceptance tests)
- Pilot SLA trial: Feb 15–21 (we will run Dedicated in reserved capacity)
- Cutover target: Feb 22

DocuSign for MAP v3: https://www.docusign.com/sign/EXAMPLE-MAP-V3 (envelope created by Stephanie)
